Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium case-study product mockup for the Knowhere Systems portfolio, showing the SocialSyncc mobile-first social publishing app. Input images are visual references for the real product, not surfaces to paste unchanged. Keep its identity: exact brand spelling 'SocialSyncc', teal #0c968c, pale mint, white rounded cards, navy typography, familiar iOS bottom navigation Home / Posts / Create / Calendar / Stats. Photorealistic graphite or silver iPhone hardware, front-facing with restrained three-quarter perspective, sharp readable main labels and clean screen geometry. Devices occupy most of the canvas, centered as one balanced isolated group, fully visible with modest margins. Transparent background with a real alpha channel everywhere outside the devices and a subtle translucent contact shadow; absolutely no floor, backdrop, rectangle, gradient canvas, scene, pedestal, decorative floating platform icons or caption outside the phones. Match the provided screen styles. Remove personal names, email addresses, dummy post text, developer details and marketing assertions such as '5,000+ brands', '10 platforms', 'Trusted globally', or guaranteed performance. Abstract record content with short neutral bars. No AI feature claims, billing, collaboration or approval features. Show only the specified product workflow. Keep all phones intact and uncropped. High-quality commercial app mockup, no watermark.
